entries.text: You see Mrs. Stapleton, the librarian.
entries.source_text: You see Mrs. Stapleton, the librarian.

entries.text: You see a middle-aged woman.
entries.source_text: You see a middle-aged woman.

entries.text: Hi, Welcome to the Library.  I don't think I have seen you around these parts before.   What might you be looking for in the way of knowledge?
entries.source_text:
Hi, Welcome to the Library.  I don't think I have seen you around these parts
 before.   What might you be looking for in the way of knowledge?

entries.text: Good to see you again.  What might you be looking for today?
entries.source_text: Good to see you again.  What might you be looking for today?

entries.text: What do you have in the way of books?

entries.text: I am looking for a Water Chip.
entries.source_text: I am looking for a Water Chip.

entries.text: Nothing, but thanks.

entries.text: Well, let me show you my selection.
entries.source_text: Well, let me show you my selection.

entries.text: Well, in my studies I have come across some references to such things.  Actually I have in my posession a Holodisk that contains a certain amount of information that you might find useful.

entries.text: A Holodisk, what is that?
entries.source_text: A Holodisk, what is that?

entries.text: Can I have the Holodisk?
entries.source_text: Can I have the Holodisk?

entries.text: A Holodisk contains information on it, but it can only be read by a certain number of electronic devices.  I see that you have a PIP Boy. You can use that to decode, review, and store the information that a Holodisk contains.

entries.text: Sounds great! Can I have the Holodisk?
entries.source_text: Sounds great! Can I have the Holodisk?

entries.text: Information is hard to come by in this day and age.  I will need to charge you 750 Hub Bucks for the disk.

entries.text: Sounds good. Here's the money.
entries.source_text: Sounds good. Here's the money.

entries.text: Now that looks like a worn Holodisk if I've ever seen one.  I'll give you 500 for it.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: How about I take a blowtorch to this whole place instead! Huh lady?!

entries.text: Sorry, don't have the cash.

entries.text: I am sorry but I can only accept the full amount for the Holodisk.  Please return when you have that amount.

entries.text: I am sorry, but you wil need to keep your pyromaniacal tendencies to yourself. Please leave.

entries.text: [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]
entries.source_text: [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]

entries.text: You are right, the Disk has seen better days.  Since that is the case, I will accept 500 instead of my original price. [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Normally, I do not give in to such methods, but to protect my collection from such a threat I will give you the Disk.  In exchange, I would ask that you never return here.

entries.text: As I may have explained, you will need to use this and then access the information through your PIP Boy.  [Mrs. Stapleton hands you the Holodisk]
